datafield.subfield: Collection of Materials Relating to the Anguillan Revolution,
Materials are arranged in the order in which they were received.

Processing Information: This collection was processed by Lauren C. Williams in August 2024. Finding aid written by Lauren C. Williams in August 2024, incorporating some description provided by the dealer.
The collection is open for research.

Consists of materials relating to the Anguillan Revolution of 1967, including the Anguillan-published newspaper The Beacon, news articles from American publications, and memorabilia. Also includes policy statements on Anguilla from the British Information Services, Economic & Political Affairs Division.
